name: Raham
title: Descendant of Caleb
summary: Raham was a descendant of Caleb through the Shamma line, mentioned in 1 Chronicles. He was the son of Shema and the father of Jorkeam. He is part of the genealogy of the tribe of Judah.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Genealogy of Judah
keyEvents.description: Raham is mentioned as the son of Shema and the father of Jorkeam in the genealogy of the tribe of Judah, as part of Caleb's descendants.

keyEvents.title: Part of Caleb's Family Line
keyEvents.description: Raham belongs to Caleb's extended family line through Maon and Shema, representing a branch of the tribe of Judah that settled in the Promised Land.

keyEvents.title: Father of Jorkeam
keyEvents.description: Raham was the father of Jorkeam, which is also a place name linked to an area in Judah, suggesting that his descendants founded or named a town.

keyEvents.title: Connection to the Hebron region
keyEvents.description: Kaleb's descendants, including Raham, are linked to the Hebron region in southern Judah, an area of great historical and spiritual significance in Israel's history.
